'''Surgical plastic''' was a synthetic material that was used for the production of implants. The underworld syndicate [[Black Sun]] used [[Spice ampoule|ampoules]] of this material to transport [[spice]] in it. For this purpose, the containers were surgically implanted under the skin of drug couriers to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] the spice past security forces unnoticed.
